traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: When the mephit dies, it leaves behind a cloud of smoke that fills a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on its space. The sphere is heavily obscured. Wind disperses the cloud, which otherwise lasts for 1 minute.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
traits.description:
The mephit can innately cast dancing lights, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.
At will: dancing lights

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cinder Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of smoldering ash. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.
